# crosswork_te_flex_algo_affinity (Data Source)

This data source can read one flexible-algorithm affinity for traffic engineering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_te_flex_algo_affinity" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `bit_position` (Number) Bit position of the affinity
- `name` (String) Name of the affinity
